description: Flexible template for creating custom stories with user-defined keywords and storylines

pages.title: The Beginning
pages.text: {childName} was happily living their life when something amazing happened. Little did {childName} know, this day would change everything!

pages.title: Sharing the Victory
pages.text: {childName} celebrated with everyone who believed in them. Sharing joy with others made it twice as sweet.

pages.text: {childName} had grown in ways they couldn't have imagined. The adventure had ended, but the growth would last forever!
